title: Core Module Primitives
summary: This module defines the foundational classes for building DSPy programs, including the base module for parameter management and the core module for program logic and execution.

nodes.label: BaseModule
nodes.title: BaseModule Class
nodes.description: Provides core functionalities for DSPy modules, including parameter management, deep copying, state serialization, and dependency versioning. It serves as the foundation for all DSPy modules.

nodes.label: Module
nodes.title: Module Class
nodes.description: The primary building block for DSPy programs. It extends BaseModule, adding capabilities for program logic (forward method), LM interaction, callback handling, and parallel execution.

nodes.label: Program Execution & Primitives
nodes.title: Program Execution and Primitives
nodes.description: The parent module encompassing core DSPy primitives and program execution logic.

nodes.label: Data Types and Interfaces
nodes.title: Data Types and Interfaces
nodes.description: Defines the fundamental data structures and interfaces used across DSPy, including LM requests, system roles, and streaming events.

groups.label: Core Abstractions
groups.title: Core Abstractions
groups.description: Fundamental classes that define the structure and behavior of DSPy programs and their components.
